groupedHumanDecisions.rationale: Twenty-nine bounded physical mechanisms may remain unchanged with V1-incomplete dose, timing or evidence metadata.
Eight existing propositions lack exact exposure, mechanism or endpoint identification.
Physical condition is not perceived state, behavior, use, capacity or Institutional condition.
Two broad package claims terminated at cheap triage.

individualScientificDecisions.rationale: Destination proximity and travel distance are inverse representations that may be semantic/derivational rather than an independent causal pair.
Noise intermittency and ambient level are distinct acoustic dimensions; intermittency does not universally cause a higher level under an unspecified aggregation window.
Green-space availability and accessibility may be nested opportunity dimensions; causal typing needs an explicit access mechanism.
Point-of-use proximity and physical option availability overlap in the current definitions; causal versus compositional typing needs review.
Task performance and annoyance vary by level, task and source; neither is an exact cognitive-load measure.
The experiment bundles heat and noise; syntheses show task, dose and adaptation dependence, blocking a broad component effect.
Ventilation, VOCs and CO2 are partly bundled; task productivity is not a broad latent capacity and a controlled child trial reports a next-day cognition null.
The specified low-intensity natural-setting walk is a coherent reusable operation identity; identity implies no mood effect, recommendation, feasibility or activation.

Approve only the immediate positive mood-valence contrast under matched natural-versus-urban walking semantics; MIXED stays mixed and all broader cognition, stress, clinical, behavior and durability claims are excluded.
